description: Test suite for the storage package, focusing on unit of work operations, workflow execution, and transaction management in an integration testing context.

methods.name: setupTestDB
methods.description: Sets up a temporary test database and returns storage instance and cleanup function.

methods.name: TestUnitOfWork_BasicOperations
methods.description: Tests basic create, register, and commit operations of a unit of work.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_AtomicWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Tests atomic storage of workflow and execution data within a unit of work.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_RollbackOnError
methods.description: Ensures rollback occurs when a transaction fails due to invalid SQL.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_UpdateWorkflowStatus
methods.description: Tests updating workflow status with new execution data atomically.
